rule.text: Default caps: queue cap 3, daily limit 5 generations, expiry 14 days, aiOnly off.
rule.note: The built-in queue of 3, the 14-day expiry and AI-written commits not required all hold, as the rule says; a team's own daily limit replaces the built-in 5 without touching the others.

title: The limits when only one is set

sourceAnchors.explanation: Works out the limits background generation runs under, from the repository settings and the built-in values.

prediction.scenario: Your team turns on background Workouts after each commit. In the repository settings, it sets just one limit: at most 2 generations a day. It sets nothing about how many Workouts may wait in the queue, or how long an untouched Workout is kept. What limits does background generation now run under?
prediction.explanation: Each limit has a built-in value: 3 Workouts waiting, 5 generations a day, AI-written commits not required, and 14 days before an untouched Workout is discarded. A limit set in the repository's settings replaces only its own built-in value. Setting the daily limit to 2 leaves the queue at 3 and the expiry at 14 days.

options.text: Up to 3 Workouts waiting, 2 generations a day, and untouched ones discarded after 14 days.
options.testName: keeps 3 waiting, allows 2 a day, and discards after 14 days

options.text: Up to 3 Workouts waiting, 5 generations a day, and untouched ones discarded after 14 days.
options.testName: keeps 3 waiting, allows 5 a day, and discards after 14 days
options.misunderstanding: You were picturing fixed limits that a team cannot change. Each limit the team sets replaces the built-in one.

options.text: Up to 3 Workouts waiting, 2 generations a day, and untouched ones discarded after 7 days.
options.testName: keeps 3 waiting, allows 2 a day, and discards after 7 days
options.misunderstanding: You were picturing a one-week life for a waiting Workout. Untouched background Workouts are kept for two weeks.

options.text: Up to 5 Workouts waiting, 2 generations a day, and untouched ones discarded after 14 days.
options.testName: keeps 5 waiting, allows 2 a day, and discards after 14 days
options.misunderstanding: You were picturing a queue of 5. At most 3 background Workouts wait at once; 5 is how many commits can wait to be looked at while another is being generated.
